summary: The flake's provider-components derivation (the four wasm guest components the resource-provider tests load) is built from only what those crates use: the root manifest's workspace-wide tables, the lock, the cargo config, components/, their WIT worlds and the root's [patch] sources, with a generated workspace manifest listing just the four. Before, its source was the whole tree, so every commit rebuilt it, in CI's test build and in every local scripts/ci-local run. The components are the same code: the same packages, versions and features resolve, and with custom sections stripped each .wasm is byte-identical to the previous build; only symbol names in the name section differ.

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: A build input change only; what the tests load is the same code.

compatibility.detail: The derivation's output path and file names are unchanged in shape; the files' name sections differ once.
